DELETE FROM coupon_templates WHERE template_id LIKE 'FY-FIX-CT-%';
DELETE FROM products WHERE product_id LIKE 'FY-FIX-%';
DELETE FROM product_skus WHERE sku_id LIKE 'FY-FIX-SKU-%';
DELETE FROM point_transactions WHERE user_id LIKE 'FY-FIX-%';
DELETE FROM sale_orders WHERE client_user_id LIKE 'FY-FIX-%';
DELETE FROM appointments WHERE client_user_id LIKE 'FY-FIX-%';
DELETE FROM client_wechat_users WHERE user_id LIKE 'FY-FIX-%';
-- link-32~44 scope/cron 夹具清理（独立于 FY-FIX- 命名空间）
